ac: AC-327 (clause order when the cap binds)
note: THE CLAUSE ORDER, ruled in fix round 2 item 2: the staleness advisory precedes the compaction advisory, so when both fire and the character budget cannot hold both, the one dropped behind (+1 more) is the CHECKPOINT clause and the operator still sees the short, actionable one. Same maximal state as session-327c (24-character wave id twice, enforce=warn, TDE-GREEN, the longest checkpoint filename pre-compact.sh can produce) plus a clock past the 24h staleness boundary, pinned in env so this case cannot rot into or out of the stale branch. stdout_absent is the load-bearing half: without it the case passes whichever clause survives.
